senses.gloss: m. (נָקַד I; cmp. Arab. naḳd probus et justi ponderi nummus) a stamped coin.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 1:3">Par. I, 3</cite> <he>בן עזאי קירהו נ׳ וכ׳</he> Ben ʿAzzai called it (the sheep between one and two years of age, when it is neither <cite ref="K00083"><he>כֶּבֶשׂ</he></cite> nor <cite ref="A01264"><he>אַיִל</he></cite>) ‘a distinct coin;’ R. Yishm. called it ‘counterfeit;’ v. <cite ref="Q01866"><he>פָּרָכָרַגְמָא</he></cite>.
